REALISTIC BACKTEST FIX (2026-02-06 21:30): Matthew caught that the first backtest used his $94.7M data instead of simulating $2,500 → growth. Created massive_strategy_search_realistic.py that properly tracks balance, uses 10% position sizing, applies 0.6% fees, and stops if account goes bust. Running in tmux session 'realistic-search' - testing 10,000 strategies (~60 min ETA). Key lesson: When something doesn't make sense (like $6M profit from $2,500), question the axiom - the backtest wasn't simulating capital growth at all.
